propositions: Advanced command grammars currently mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch, making them non-reusable and causing unsafe/incomplete top-level help forms.
Parser factories must be extracted into lean S2a side-effect-free modules that import no optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing).
Parse-failure seam must be reconciled so that RebarArgumentParser.error() raising ParseError produces identical exit code (2) and stderr/usage bytes as current SystemExit(2) behavior.

Bespoke parser presentation (usage=, RawDescriptionHelpFormatter, add_help=False) must be preserved explicitly through optional keyword arguments while all migrated parsers return RebarArgumentParser.
All registered advanced routes must have valid factory references and be deterministically generation-ready for S2d without executing handlers or importing optional dependencies.
Production-path tests must verify no delta in nested selection, accepted/rejected argv, diagnostics, streams, exit codes, and help/usage byte output for byte-identical commands.
